entries.text: Archiv 14356–58 / later Originals 449 711-2 — Beethovensaal, Hannover, December 1960 (suites 3 and 6 also tagged February 1961 on some MusicBrainz/Presto faces), producer Karl-Heinz Schneider, engineer Heinz Wildhagen — is Fournier’s circulated studio cycle for Archiv, not the 1959 Accord Radio Suisse set, not Toranomon 1972, and not Geneva Philips 1976–77. Modern cello, modern pitch, French-school lyricism: Gramophone’s CD-era notice still praised eloquence and tightly reined rubato while warning out-and-out purists that this is not Bylsma’s baroque RCA world. Among the assessed cards for these suites it is the Référence — the mid-century modern document the catalogue actually signed — not a HIP statement and not Casals’s championship urgency.
